It also describes paid access to a VIP signals community with stated prices and payment options, while a visible disclaimer characterizes the material as educational rather than financial advice and warns of possible total investment loss.

opening.argument: The video links a paid participation step to a crypto-upside narrative. It presents AVAX as moving toward a possible breakout and identifies a projected target around $11.4, then directs viewers to a VIP group where buy and sell signals are shared. The requested path is concrete: click the description link, choose a plan, enter an email, complete payment, and access the signals group. That makes the market-upside presentation function as solicitation for paid access, rather than merely detached commentary.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Conditional wording does not eliminate the solicitation. The video still places the paid VIP offer directly after a forecast of a breakout and target, and it gives a step-by-step route to payment. Calling the material analysis does not change that viewers are being directed from the AVAX thesis into a paid signals service.

citations.quote: the structure still favors the upside

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The forecast is expressly conditional and does not promise that viewers will obtain appreciation or profit. The cited target is described as a future possibility after confirmation, while the paid service is described as access to signals, not as a guaranteed investment outcome. The payment flow therefore does not establish that buying AVAX or any asset is required or that returns are promised.

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: crypto-market upside framing, an external Telegram destination, paid plans, email collection, recurring card billing, and crypto payment. The description advertises a VIP paid signals group, while the spoken instructions tell viewers to choose between monthly and yearly pricing and then pay by card or USDT. The flow culminates in access to buy and sell signals. Even without an explicit guarantee, this combination creates a paid crypto-participation funnel built around a forecasted upside move.

citations.quote: VIP Paid Signals Group: 👉 https://t.me/cnmarmy_bot
$40 per month or $20 per month if you pay yearly
choose payment card for easy auto renew or USDT on Binance Smart Chain
Click the VIP signals link to enter the group where all buy and sell signals are shared.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The disclaimer is not a complete answer to the funnel evidence. The video still advertises an external paid Telegram service, explains auto-renewing payment, and shows a payment-method screen. A warning about risk can coexist with persuasive promotion; it does not remove the commercial request or the crypto-linked sales context.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These are payment and access details for a subscription, not evidence of a promised asset return. The video explicitly says there are no get-rich-quick scams and advises risk management, while the analysis identifies both bullish and bearish conditions. External payment and crypto terminology are not, by themselves, proof that the service promises appreciation or deceptive returns.

opening.argument: The apparent chart lesson also operates as a sales presentation. The speaker first establishes credibility by claiming the prior structure unfolded as mapped, describes a valid double bottom and upside-leaning setup, and then transitions into instructions for joining a paid VIP community. The call to click the description, select a plan, pay, and enter a group supplying buy and sell signals shows that the analysis is being used to steer viewers toward paid crypto participation, not simply to inform them about markets.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The educational label does not answer the sequencing and call to action. The video uses its claimed successful prior mapping and bullish structure to build confidence, then provides operational payment instructions. The disclaimer may qualify liability, but it does not negate the promotional role of the analysis in selling access to signals.

The paid community provides signals; the quoted material does not say that joining guarantees gains or requires purchasing AVAX.
